svg.title: Typical discretisation error against element size
svg.desc: Log–log plot of relative error against element size. Straight lines of slope 1, 2 and 3 show the expected rates for stress and displacement at element orders 1 and 2. A dashed red line shows a peak stress at a re-entrant corner growing as the elements get smaller.
svg.text: peak stress at a re-entrant corner: grows
